content:
We are looking for an experienced AWS - EKS Platform Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud Platform Engineering, EKS, Infrastructure Automation, and Cloud Migration. This is an excellent opportunity for senior cloud professionals who enjoy building scalable cloud platforms, driving enterprise transformation, and automating infrastructure.

🚀 Hiring: AWS - EKS Platform Engineer NO AI (Independent Candidates Only)
📍 Location: Reston, VA (Hybrid – Onsite 1x per Month)
📌 Local Candidates Only (Valid Driver's License Required)
💼 Job Type: Contract
🎥 Interview Process: Video Interview + Face-to-Face

Must-Have Qualifications
✅ 10+ years of overall IT experience
✅ 5+ years of AWS Cloud Platform Engineering experience
✅ Minimum one AWS Certification (Required)
✅ Strong experience migrating applications from on-premises to AWS
✅ SME-level expertise in AWS Provisioning & Platform Engineering
✅ Extensive hands-on experience with Amazon EKS and Kubernetes
✅ Strong knowledge of EC2, VPC, Networking, Gateways, Security Groups, IAM, ELB, Lambda, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, S3, Direct Connect, and Subnets
✅ Expert-level Terraform experience for Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
✅ Strong Linux Administration and Bash scripting experience
✅ Python programming including Boto3 and Lambda development
✅ Automation using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, and AWS CDK
✅ Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Git, and DevOps toolchains
✅ Experience with SRE principles and Cloud Transformation initiatives

Note: This role focuses on AWS Platform Engineering and Amazon EKS. AI/ML backgrounds are NOT the target for this requirement.


📩 Interested candidates? Please send your updated resume at abhay@sourceinfotech.com
comment: EKS roles often succeed or fail on operational maturity—cluster governance, observability, security controls, and upgrade strategy matter as much as provisioning expertise.
